description: Update the UI to allow algorithm selection and support multi-process/gestion management. Users can select which algorithm to use, see previous executions listed, and start new processes without clearing the DB.
steps: Update src/app/dashboard/scheduler/page.tsx: Add algorithm selector (radio buttons or dropdown) for 'Iterativo', 'Greedy con Scoring', 'Genetico'. Show genetic-specific params (population size, generations, mutation rate) only when genetico is selected. Wire the selected algorithm into the config sent to the API.

Update src/app/dashboard/resultados/page.tsx: Instead of only showing the single active execution, fetch all executions and let the user pick which one to view. Show a list/table of past executions with: id, gestion, algorithm used, date, stats (assigned/conflicts). Keep the current detail view when an execution is selected.

Create src/app/api/scheduler/ejecuciones/route.ts: A GET endpoint that returns all ejecuciones ordered by createdAt desc, with basic stats (id, gestion, algoritmo, totalAsignadas, totalConflictos, duracionMs, createdAt, activa). This feeds the results page execution picker.

Update src/app/dashboard/resultados/results-client.tsx: Add an execution selector/list at the top. When the user picks a different execution, reload that execution's assignments and conflicts. The component should accept an optional ejecucionId prop or use URL params to navigate between executions.

Ensure the API route at src/app/api/scheduler/run/route.ts does NOT deactivate previous executions of same gestion anymore - each execution is independent. Just insert the new one as activa=true without deactivating others. (Or keep deactivation only for same-gestion if that's the multi-process intent - the user wants independent processes, so remove the deactivation step.)
acceptance_criteria: The scheduler page shows algorithm selection with 3 options
Genetic-specific parameters appear only when genetic algorithm is selected
The results page lists all past executions and allows selecting any of them to view details
A new API endpoint GET /api/scheduler/ejecuciones returns all executions
Running the scheduler does not deactivate previous executions - all coexist independently
verification: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` in project root and confirm 0 errors
findings: All changes compile cleanly. The scheduler page now shows 3 algorithm cards with genetic params conditionally displayed. The results page uses searchParams-based navigation for execution selection (option a from the briefing). The ejecuciones API endpoint follows the same auth pattern as other routes. Removed the deactivation block so all executions coexist independently in the DB.
